basic_details.job_title: CRA College Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 38 Teaching Post, Librarian Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Governing Body of CRA College, Sonepat (Haryana Govt. aided, affiliated to M. D. University, Rohtak) has invited online applications for 38 vacant posts: teaching posts in 13 subjects (Commerce, Hindi, Botany, Zoology, Mathematics, Geography, Chemistry, Physical Education, English, Political Science, History, Physics and Economics) and one Librarian post, sanctioned under grant-in-aid by the State Govt. on a regular basis. Applications are made only through the Online Application Portal linked at www.cracollegesonepat.org, which opened on 22 November 2026 and closes on 12 December 2026 at

application_fee.details: The fee is non-refundable and is to be paid online only.

how_to_apply: Open the Online Application Portal through the link given at www.cracollegesonepat.org. Applications are accepted online only; no application will be accepted through offline mode.
Submit the online application between 22 November 2026 and 12 December 2026 (11:59 PM).
Pay the non-refundable application fee online.
Take hard copies of the online application and attach self-attested photocopies of the certificates/documents/testimonials, along with the NOC from the present employer, if applicable.
Submit the hard copies to the Dean, College Development Council, M. D. University, Rohtak.
Submit the hard copies also to the Director General, Higher Education, Shiksha Sadan, Sec-05, Panchkula, Haryana, within the prescribed date and time.
Hard copy of the online application
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer (if applicable)
important_instructions: Incomplete applications and applications submitted after the last date will not be considered. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Reservation is applied as prescribed by the latest UGC/MDU/State Govt. and DHE Haryana norms.

content_sections.heading: About CRA College Sonepat
content_sections.text: CRA College is a Haryana Government aided college in Sonepat (PIN 131001), affiliated to M. D. University, Rohtak. This recruitment is issued by the President of its Governing Body. The posts are advertised in reference to the Directorate General of Higher Education (DGHE), Panchkula letter No. 08/18-2026 C-4(1) dated 11.11.2026. The college can be contacted on Ph: 9355879426 or at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The 38 posts are distributed subject-wise as below. The category codes are copied exactly as printed in the notice (BCA, BCB, OSC, DSC, EWS, GEN; ESM, PH-HH, PH-VH and PH-OH are shown in brackets against a category). The vacancies include the backlog of reserved categories. Three posts are earmarked for candidates with disabilities within a category (Hindi: GEN (PH-HH), History: GEN (PH-VH), Physics: EWS (PH-OH)), and one Physical Education post is GEN (ESM).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice does not list subject-wise qualifications. For all 38 posts, the rules for eligibility conditions, age, age relaxation, reservation and qualification apply as prescribed by the latest norms and guidelines of UGC/MDU/State Govt. and the Directorate of Higher Education, Haryana, Panchkula, vide notifications dated 11.11.2022, 12.12.2022 and 18.04.2023. Educational qualification: the official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; it follows the norms named above. Age limit and age relaxation: as prescribed by the same norms; no figure is printed in the notice. Candidates who are currently employed must attach a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if applicable. Candidates should check the official notification and the norms it names for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The posts are sanctioned under grant-in-aid by the State Govt. on a regular basis. The notice prints no pay amount: the pay scale is applicable as prescribed by the latest norms and guidelines of UGC/MDU/State Govt. and the Directorate of Higher Education, Haryana, Panchkula (notifications dated 11.11.2022, 12.12.2022 and 18.04.2023).

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable and is to be paid online only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRA College Sonepat Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Online Application Portal through the link given at www.cracollegesonepat.org . Applications are accepted online only; no application will be accepted through offline mode. Submit the online application between 22 November 2026 and 12 December 2026 (11:59 PM). Pay the non-refundable application fee online. Take hard copies of the online application and attach self-attested photocopies of the certificates/documents/testimonials, along with the NOC from the present employer, if applicable. Submit the hard copies to the Dean, College Development Council, M. D. University, Rohtak. Submit the hard copies also to the Director General, Higher Education, Shiksha Sadan, Sec-05, Panchkula, Haryana, within the prescribed date and time. Hard copy of the online application Self-attested photocopies of certificates/documents/testimonials No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications and applications submitted after the last date will not be considered. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Reservation is applied as prescribed by the latest UGC/MDU/State Govt. and DHE Haryana norms.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CRA College Sonepat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 38 posts: 37 teaching posts in 13 subjects and one Librarian post, with English (6), Commerce (5) and Geography (5) having the most.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CRA College Sonepat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Online Application Portal closes on 12 December 2026 at 11:59 PM; it opened on 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CRA College Sonepat teaching posts?
faq.answer: Qualification, age and age relaxation follow the latest norms of UGC/MDU/State Govt. and the Directorate of Higher Education, Haryana, as per notifications dated 11.11.2022, 12.12.2022 and 18.04.2023.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for CRA College Sonepat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- for General/EWS, Rs. 250/- for SC/BC and Nil for PH candidates, payable online only and non-refundable.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for CRA College Sonepat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only through the Online Application Portal linked at www.cracollegesonepat.org; offline applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q6. Where must the hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: Hard copies with self-attested photocopies of certificates must be submitted to the Dean, College Development Council, M. D. University, Rohtak and to the Director General, Higher Education, Shiksha Sadan, Sec-05, Panchkula, Haryana, within the prescribed date and time.

faq.question: Q7. Are the CRA College Sonepat posts regular?
faq.answer: Yes, the posts are sanctioned under grant-in-aid by the State Govt. on a regular basis, including the backlog of reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. Is an NOC required for CRA College Sonepat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview.
